# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## Enzymes

[Eznyme manufacturer-Biovencer]

Biovencer Healthcare is one of the leading enzyme suppliers, distributors & exporters in India.
Enzymes are biocatalysts that when present in a chemical reaction, increase the rate of a reaction
without affecting the property and nature of the end product. Almost all enzymes are proteins, but
not all proteins are enzymes.

Enzymes are highly specific in their action; therefore, each enzyme catalyzes only one type of
reaction. Enzyme activity can be influenced by a change in pH, temperature, and the concentration of
substrate present and can be described by the Turnover Number. Our range of Enzymes that are
distinctive, reliable, and 100%  safe for consumption.

## Enzymes

[Eznyme manufacturer-Biovencer]

Biovencer Healthcare is one of the leading enzyme suppliers, distributors & exporters in India.
Enzymes are biocatalysts that when present in a chemical reaction, increase the rate of a reaction
without affecting the property and nature of the end product. Almost all enzymes are proteins, but
not all proteins are enzymes.

Enzymes are highly specific in their action; therefore, each enzyme catalyzes only one type of
reaction. Enzyme activity can be influenced by a change in pH, temperature, and the concentration of
substrate present and can be described by the Turnover Number. Our range of Enzymes that are
distinctive, reliable, and 100%  safe for consumption.

### Sassoon Hospital

Sassoon General Hospitals is a large state-run hospital in Pune, India with 1296 beds. It is
affiliated to the B. J. Medical College and a Nurses training School. Sassoon Hospital caters to
9,426,959 population of Pune District- a 2nd most populous district in the State of Maharashtra. The
Jewish philanthropist David Sassoon from Mumbai made a generous donation to make the construction of
the hospital possible in 1867. The hospital could originally accommodate 144 patients.

affiliated to the B. J. Medical College and a Nurses training School. Sassoon Hospital caters to
9,426,959 population of Pune District- a 2nd most populous district in the State of Maharashtra. The
Jewish philanthropist David Sassoon from Mumbai made a generous donation to make the construction of
the hospital possible in 1867. The hospital could originally accommodate 144 patients.
